rainmeterSectionOptions.notes: MouseOver/Leave toggle visibility of the settings-gear meter group 'Controls' (fades in gear icon on hover). Not otherwise relevant to static pixel layout.

localVariables.notes: Gpu1Name is the only content-identity override in this panel; ShowGraph=1 is the runtime-mutable toggle persisted back to this file's [Variables] via !WriteKeyValue when the user clicks the collapse/expand graph button.

gpu.notes: GpuTypeInteger=0 selects the NVIDIA branch (percent-of-VRAM sensor based total-memory calc). GpuTypeString=V makes the '[#GpuTypeString]' substitutions in measure/meter names resolve to the 'V' (video-memory) branch: GpuVMemoryPercent / GpuTotalVMem. The AMD 'dedicated memory' branch (GpuTotalDedMem/GpuDedMemoryPercent, and thus Gpu1MemoryInMegaBytes=2048) is present in the ini but Disabled=1 for this NVIDIA config and produces no visible output — 2048 is an inert leftover default, NOT the RTX 5070 Ti's real VRAM size.

devTempWarnColors.notes: Used by GpuTempWarn Calc measure (not GpuTempColor) to color the numeric temperature text: <45=Th1(sky blue), <55=Th2(yellow), <65=Th3(orange), <75=Th4(red), >=75=Th5(dark red).

hwinfoSensorResolution.notes: All GPU1 HWiNFO sensors share SensorId=0xe0002000 / SensorInstance=0x14 (20) — i.e. one HWiNFO enumerated sensor object (the RTX 5070 Ti GPU) — differentiated only by EntryId (the specific reading within that sensor). Resolved from @Resources/HWiNFO.inc [HWiNFO-Config-GPU1] block.

measures.name: GpuTempWarn
measures.notes: Drives GpuTempText's dynamic FontColor. Result is a color-string, consumed via [GpuTempWarn] meter reference.

measures.name: GpuCoreUsageBarWarn
measures.notes: Drives GpuCoreUsageBar's BarColor. Threshold literal 75 (not a named variable).

measures.name: GpuUsedMem
measures.notes: Raw allocated VRAM in MB, no explicit Min/Max set.

measures.name: GpuUsedMemRound
measures.notes: Integer-rounded MB value used in GpuMemoryValue text.

measures.name: GpuVMemoryPercent
measures.notes: ACTIVE branch for this NVIDIA GPU (GpuTypeInteger=0). Referenced dynamically elsewhere as 'Gpu[#GpuTypeString]MemoryPercent' -> GpuVMemoryPercent.

measures.name: GpuTotalVMem
measures.notes: ACTIVE. Derives total VRAM (MB) by back-solving used-MB from the used-% sensor. Referenced in GpuMemoryValue text as '[&GpuTotal[#GpuTypeString]Mem]' -> [&GpuTotalVMem].

measures.name: GpuTotalDedMem
measures.notes: INACTIVE for this GPU (GpuTypeInteger=0 makes the OR-clause true -> Disabled). AMD-only fallback path, unused for the RTX 5070 Ti.

measures.name: GpuDedMemoryPercent
measures.notes: INACTIVE for this GPU, same reasoning as GpuTotalDedMem.

measures.name: MeasureSettingsScript
measures.notes: Utility Lua measure exposing GetKey/Gsub used only by StyleStringButtonHover / StyleMouseRegionStringButtonHover (hover recolor of the settings-gear and collapse/expand icons). Not part of the static/steady-state visual — irrelevant to a non-interactive Direct2D re-render, but needed if hover states are reproduced.

backgroundGeometry.note: All coordinates below are UNSCALED (pre multiply-by-#Scale#=1.7). Every rectangle in this style is defined in unscaled units then multiplied by Scale at draw time; Scale is applied uniformly (no separate per-shape scale).
backgroundGeometry.outerHeightUnscaled: = [MeterBackgroundHeight:Y]  (see verticalFlowSummary; = 78 + 5*T, T = auto text-line-height, see notes)

shapes.notes: No fill/stroke of its own — exists purely to be Unioned with Shape (Shape3=Combine Shape|Union Shape2), squaring off the rounded rect's bottom edge so the top piece reads as 'rounded-top, flat-bottom'.

rect.h: [[MeterBackground]:H] - ((BgShapeX+12.3)*2)  [self-referential; uses this same Shape meter's own scaled H, i.e. (outerHeightUnscaled*Scale) - (17.3*2)*Scale ≈ (outerHeightUnscaled-34.6)*Scale, evaluated in SCALED units since :H already includes *Scale]

shapes.notes: Unioned with Shape4 (Shape6=Combine Shape4|Union Shape5) to square off Shape4's TOP edge, so the bottom piece reads as 'flat-top, rounded-bottom' and the two pieces (top+bottom) visually overlap/meet around y=24-29.5 to form one continuous card with a 2-tone fill (lighter blue-grey header strip 5..~24, body grey 24..bottom).

stroke.width: Stroke_Width*Scale = 0*1.7 = 0 (effectively invisible stroke — width resolves to 0)

fill.notes: transparent fill; this shape exists only for its (currently zero-width) stroke outline

companionMeter.name: MeterBackgroundHeight
companionMeter.purpose: Invisible (alpha 0) 1px-tall sizing meter placed at the bottom of the real content flow; its resolved Y value is read back by StyleBackground's H formula ([MeterBackgroundHeight:Y]*Scale) to auto-fit the background to however many rows/graphs are currently visible.

meters.name: MeterBackground
meters.notes: Draws the full two-zone rounded background card; see 'backgroundGeometry' for the resolved unscaled shape geometry.

meters.name: meterTitle
meters.textResolved: RTX 5070 TI (displayed upper-cased by StringCase=UPPER -> "RTX 5070 TI")
meters.notes: Panel title. Text is static per-session (UpdateDivider=-1).

meters.name: meterHideGraphs_
meters.fontFace: Trebuchet MS (inherited default; styleButton does not override FontFace)
meters.textNotes: Unicode escape U+23F6 (collapse/'hide graph' glyph, up-pointing).
meters.notes: Visible collapse-graph button icon (ShowGraph=1 by default so this is the one shown, not meterShowGraphs_). Click target is the separate invisible meter 'meterHideGraphs' (skipped, see 'skipped').

meters.name: meterShowGraphs_
meters.textNotes: Literal ini text includes a stray '0x' ('\x0x23F7'); intended glyph is almost certainly U+23F7 (expand/'show graph' glyph, down-pointing), mirroring meterHideGraphs_'s U+23F6.
meters.notes: Same on-screen position as meterHideGraphs_ (Y explicitly copied from it); only one of the two button glyphs is ever visible at a time. Currently HIDDEN because ShowGraph=1.

meters.name: GpuTempText
meters.notes: Top-center temperature readout, centered above the GPU:/percent row. Font color ramps through DevTempWarnColorTh1..5 based on GpuTempWarnTh1..4 (45/55/65/75).

meters.name: GpuUsageText
meters.notes: Static label, left-aligned, same row as GpuTempText's row+2 (i.e. one row below the temperature).

meters.name: GpuUsagePercentText

y.note: StyleRightAlign_r's Y=r overrides styleFirstLineText's absolute Y=32 (same numeric result here)

meters.notes: Same row as GpuUsageText: 'GPU:' left, usage% right.

meters.name: GpuCoreUsageBar
meters.notes: Thin 1px progress bar directly under the GPU:/usage% row, track color EmptyBarColor(255,255,255,25).

meters.name: GpuMemoryUsageString
meters.notes: Static label starting the VRAM row.

meters.name: GpuMemoryValue
meters.notes: Centered secondary-style text; wait — actually GpuUsageValue's y is computed via r relative to GpuMemoryUsageString's Y (not bottom), giving the same Y (35+2T algebraically resolves consistent with chain, see verticalFlowSummary).

meters.name: GpuMemoryPercent
meters.notes: Same row as GpuMemoryValue: 'usedMB/totalMB' centered, '%' right-aligned.

meters.name: GpuMemUsageBar

y.expr: (#RowSpacing#-1)R (from StyleBar; no explicit Y override in this meter)

meters.notes: VRAM progress bar under the MEM: row.

meters.name: GpuFanText
meters.notes: Static label starting the fan row.

meters.name: meterGpuFanPercent
meters.notes: Same row as meterGpuFanRpm: 'NNNN rpm' centered, '%' right-aligned.

meters.name: GpuFanBar
meters.notes: Fan-speed progress bar under the FAN: row. Normal color is GpuFanColor=0,191,255 (sky blue), per task context.

meters.name: GpuCoreMHZ

w.note: explicit W overrides default (no-W) so the SolidColor fill spans the FULL content width, from X=7 to X=197 (=RightAlign) — i.e. a full-width footer highlight band behind both CORE: and MEM: text

solidColor.notes: Light near-white background fill band drawn behind this row only (footer/label styling).

meters.notes: Bottom row, left half: core clock. The SolidColor rectangle set here (full ContentWidth) is the visual background for the ENTIRE clocks row, underlapping GpuMemMHZ too.

meters.name: GpuMemMHZ
meters.notes: Bottom row, right half: memory clock. Shares the SolidColor band drawn by GpuCoreMHZ (no own SolidColor).

meters.name: meterHistogram
meters.notes: Background/empty-track rectangle for the sparkline area; the 4 Line meters below overlay this exact rect. This is the one meter whose Y offset (BottomMargin+1=4R) creates the visual gap between the clocks row and the graph block.

meters.name: GpuTempHistogram
meters.lineColorVar: GpuTempColor (alpha defaults to 255, overriding StyleGraph's default colorHistogramAlpha=250)
meters.notes: Temperature sparkline, red line, overlaid on meterHistogram's track. Range fixed 0-100 (GpuTemp measure Min/Max), Autoscale=0.

meters.name: GpuUsageHistogram
meters.notes: Core-usage sparkline, light blue-grey line, same overlaid rect.

meters.name: GpuMemUsageHistogram
meters.notes: VRAM% sparkline, green line, same overlaid rect.

meters.name: GpuFanHistogram
meters.notes: Fan% sparkline, sky-blue line, same overlaid rect. All 4 histogram lines share one rectangle: 4 stacked/overlaid line-graphs, not 4 separate boxes.

solidColor.notes: Fully transparent (alpha 0) — invisible; exists purely as a same-size/same-Group flow anchor so the subsequent MeterBackgroundHeight meter's 'R' offset is measured from a reliable, always-present element regardless of which individual histogram lines are hidden.

meters.name: MeterBackgroundHeight
meters.notes: TERMINAL meter of the vertical flow. Its resolved Y (78+5T unscaled) is read by StyleBackground's H formula to size MeterBackground/the whole card. This is the authoritative 'total content height' value — see verticalFlowSummary.

skipped.name: ControlSettings_
skipped.reason: Group=Controls settings-gear glyph (ElegantIcons font, text [\x0xe035]); Hidden=1 always, only shown transiently via the panel-level MouseOverAction toggling group 'Controls' visibility on hover. Not part of the static steady-state visual.

skipped.name: ControlSettings
skipped.reason: Group=Controls invisible StyleMouseRegion hit-region paired with ControlSettings_; LeftMouseUpAction opens the Settings config. Non-visual (SolidColor alpha effectively via StyleMouseRegion=255,255,255,0).

skipped.name: meterHideGraphs
skipped.reason: Invisible StyleMouseRegion hit-region paired with the VISIBLE meterHideGraphs_ arrow glyph (which IS included in 'meters'). Purely a click target (SolidColor 255,255,255,0) sized/positioned to match meterHideGraphs_ via the StyleMouseRegion formula; clicking sets ShowGraph=0. No independent visual footprint.

skipped.name: meterShowGraphs
skipped.reason: Invisible StyleMouseRegion hit-region paired with meterShowGraphs_ (also hidden by default); clicking sets ShowGraph=1. No independent visual footprint.

verticalFlowSummary: T := the unscaled single-line auto-measured text height for an 8pt Trebuchet MS string meter (Rainmeter leaves H unset on every text meter here, so H is whatever the text-rendering engine measures for one line at FontSize=8; styleFirstLineText/stylePrimaryText are Bold, styleSecondaryText is Regular — assumed to share the same line-height T, which is normally true for a single font family/size since ascent+descent+line-gap are font-design metrics rather than per-weight metrics, but verify empirically against the actual renderer). Resolved unscaled Y-chain (top to bottom): meterTitle y=9,h=20 (fixed, absolute) | [ControlSettings_/gear icon: Y=10, not part of visible flow] | meterHideGraphs_/meterShowGraphs_ button y=4 (absolute, independent of the row flow, upper-right corner) | GpuTempText y=30 (absolute) | GpuUsageText y=32 (absolute) | GpuUsagePercentText y=32 (same row) | GpuCoreUsageBar y=32+T, h=1 | GpuMemoryUsageString y=34+T, h=T | GpuMemoryValue y=35+2T, h=T | GpuMemoryPercent y=35+2T (same row) | GpuMemUsageBar y=35+3T, h=1 | GpuFanText y=36+3T, h=T | meterGpuFanRpm y=36+3T (same row) | meterGpuFanPercent y=36+3T (same row) | GpuFanBar y=36+4T, h=1 | GpuCoreMHZ y=39+4T, h=T | GpuMemMHZ y=39+4T (same row) | meterHistogram/GpuTempHistogram/GpuUsageHistogram/GpuMemUsageHistogram/GpuFanHistogram/meterHistogramAlign all y=43+5T, h=25 (5 meters stacked at the identical rect: 1 empty-track image + 4 overlaid line graphs + 1 transparent align spacer) | MeterBackgroundHeight y=78+5T (TERMINAL — this value, times Scale=1.7, is the background card's total unscaled-then-scaled height). Approximate illustrative numbers using a placeholder T≈11 (NOT authoritative — replace with real measured text-layout height): rows at y≈43,43,43,68,69,80,81,91,92,102,103,113,114,124,113(clocks)≈124, graph block at y≈128..153, card total height ≈ 133 unscaled ≈ 226px at Scale=1.7. All X positions and all Bar/Graph/Image heights ARE fully static/resolved (no dependency on T): title X=103 W=190 H=20; text rows X=7/103/197 (left/center/right); bars X=8 W=188 H=1; graphs X=8 W=188 H=25; clocks-row solid-fill band X=7 W=190 (spans full content width, i.e. reaches X=197).
notes: Panel shows all optional rows/graphs enabled by default (GpuTemp=GpuUsage=GpuMem=GpuFan=GpuCoreMemClock=1; GpuTempGraph=GpuUsageGraph=GpuMemUsageGraph=GpuFanGraph=1; ShowGraph=1) — this is the 'full' 6-row + sparkline layout described in the task context.

GPU identity is NVIDIA (GpuTypeInteger=0, GpuTypeString='V'): VRAM total/percent come from GpuVMemoryPercent (HWiNFO 'GPU Memory Usage (%)' sensor) + GpuTotalVMem (back-solved from used-MB/used-%), NOT from a hardcoded capacity. The AMD 'dedicated memory' calc measures (GpuTotalDedMem, GpuDedMemoryPercent) and the Gpu1MemoryInMegaBytes=2048 variable are present but Disabled and unused for this card.

Temperature text color and both usage/mem/fan bar colors are threshold-driven Calc measures (Substitute-based), not static — GpuTempWarn uses the generic 5-step DevTempWarnColorTh1..5 ramp keyed off GpuTempWarnTh1..4 (45/55/65/75); the three bar-warn Calc measures each use a flat >75% crimson (220,20,60) vs. their respective normal color (GpuUsageColor/GpuMemUsageColor/GpuFanColor).

The 4 sparkline Line meters (temp/usage/mem/fan) all render into the exact same 188x25 rect starting at unscaled (8, 43+5T) — they are literally stacked/overlaid, not tiled side by side; the empty-track Image meter (meterHistogram, EmptyBarColor 255,255,255,25) sits behind them as the visual 'track' background.

GpuCoreMHZ draws a full-content-width (190 unscaled) near-white (248,248,248,255) SolidColor rectangle behind the CORE:/MEM: clock row only — this is a distinct footer highlight band not present on any other row in this panel.

Every meter/style carries TransformationMatrix=#Scale#;0;0;#Scale#;#Scale#;#Scale# (= 1.7;0;0;1.7;1.7;1.7): uniform 1.7x scale on both axes plus a +1.7,+1.7 translate baked into the same matrix, applied per-meter (not a single outer viewport transform) — apply this per meter/shape when reconstructing in Direct2D.

Two Rainmeter-side typos observed in the raw ini text worth flagging for a faithful re-implementation: meterShowGraphs_'s Text is written '[\x0x23F7]' (stray '0x'), and ControlSettings_'s Text is written '[\x0xe035]' (also stray '0x'); both are almost certainly meant to be plain '\x23F7' / '\xE035' Unicode escapes matching the pattern used by meterHideGraphs_'s clean '[\x23F6]'.
[styleGraphButton] is defined globally in Styles.inc but is NOT referenced anywhere in GPU1.ini — irrelevant to this panel.

[TextStyle] (referenced by the skipped ControlSettings_ meter as 'MeterStyle=TextStyle | StyleRightAlign') was not found defined in @Resources/Styles.inc or @Resources/Variables.inc in this scan; since ControlSettings_ is skipped (Group=Controls, non-steady-state), this was not chased further — flag if the settings-gear affordance needs to be reproduced.

MeasureSettingsScript (Settings.lua) plus StyleMouseRegionStringButtonHover/StyleStringButtonHover only implement HOVER recoloring of the gear/collapse-expand icons (fade via hoverAlpha=180) and are irrelevant to a non-interactive static render.

rainmeterUpdateMs=1000 is the skin-level default poll interval; several meters/measures use UpdateDivider=-1 (render once, e.g. static labels, background, title) while the live numeric readouts use UpdateDivider=1 (every update) or a Hidden-mirroring ((cond)?(-1):(1)) that only pauses updates when the row is fully hidden.

All color 'alpha' values default to 255 when a variable/literal supplies only 3 RGB components (e.g. GpuTempColor, GpuUsageColor, GpuMemUsageColor, GpuFanColor when used directly as LineColor/BarColor overrides) — this differs slightly from StyleGraph's own default LineColor which carries colorHistogramAlpha=250; each histogram meter's explicit LineColor override supersedes that default alpha.
